notes.title: 🪖EXFIL FIELD REPORT 2
notes.content:
[h3]Attention Operators![/h3][p]Field Reports are back! In this update, we’re highlighting what’s been recently added to EXFIL and giving you a glimpse of what’s on the horizon. From a brand-new map to dynamic spawn mechanics and fresh gear, there’s plenty to dig into. [/p][h2]🗺️ NEW MAP: STONE DRAGON[/h2][p]
Now available, [b]Stone Dragon[/b] drops you into a harsh yet vibrant landscape of jagged rock formations, lush jungle undergrowth, winding paths, and punishing verticality. Set deep within a rocky valley, Stone Heart is built to reward smart positioning, coordinated movement, and close-quarters chaos.

[b]Points of Interest

Mining HQ[/b] – A network of industrial buildings and heavy machinery nestled deep in the jungle. Expect prime opportunities for extraction ambushes and plenty of elevation play.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/c1c0604b3c0588d9f413636dbdb985d67538598a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Chasm Fortress[/b] – A military base at the base of a towering rock chasm. Overlooked by a railway bridge and flanked by a mining tunnel that cuts through the mountain - watch for ambushes from above and close-quarters combat below.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/d6889b968d7889f3180bfb8ccb58fee39273a12c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Riverside Village[/b] – A rundown hillside village overlooking a massive scenic waterfall. Elevated terrain and shanty-style buildings offer concealment from potential ambushes along the treeline.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/283d95e11ccf18a82c296a3d5f63271a37f6bcb1.png"][/img][b]Mountain Ruins[/b] – Perched atop Stone Dragon's highest peak, these ancient ruins offer vertical firefights and trap-laden ambush opportunities. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/203d9c278976c7ba0b57b50f8d3925fc2660072a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Blood Mines[/b] – The heart of the abandoned excavation zone. Rusting machinery and crimson-tinted pools hide danger in every corner.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/415348fb08996a757c7524c8162450d176a496d3.png"][/img]Whether you’re flanking on foot or dropping in from above, Stone Dragon is one of our most tactically diverse maps to date.  [/p][h2]🚁 NEW RESPAWN SYSTEM: HELICOPTER INSERTIONS[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/42b2ac48536a5eea11736a547a8a86eed17c649a.gif"][/img]
Gone are the days of static spawn points-welcome to [b]helicopter-based respawns[/b]. This new system inserts players via AI-controlled choppers using [b]randomized flight paths[/b] and [b]dynamic drop zones[/b].[/p][p]Each match now feels fresh and unpredictable, with pacing tuned for larger maps and more dynamic encounters.

[b][i]Dev Tip:[/i][/b][i] Keep your eyes peeled during descent-spotting other helicopters can give you an early clue where rival squads are landing.[/i][/p][p]This system is designed to keep downtime to a minimum and ensure you stay in the fight alongside your squad. Here’s how it works:[/p][list][*][p]Players can late join for a limited time after a match begins.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reinforcement waves[/b] (based on server settings) allow groups to re-enter together and bolster their remaining squad.[/p][/*][*][p]Players will redeploy to their original insertion point, but we are also exploring the idea of dynamic redeployment points where players can insert at locations assigned by teammates.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]🔫 NEW WEAPON ADDITIONS: SMG ARSENAL [/h2][p]Recently, three new weapons have joined the fight:[/p][list][*][p][b]MPX[/b] – SMG built for precision and control, ideal for close-to-mid-range engagements with excellent handling.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/ecdd0abde93bbb26463bdb502e6237d2b4e4587d.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]MP7[/b] – Compact SMG offering high fire rate and mobility, perfect for aggressive pushes and tight corners.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/99a41d0df39fe2651eb78ae392c574faad230d38.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]M27 Law[/b] – Rocket launcher designed for quick deployment and decisive takedowns of fortified positions. And remember-don’t waste your LAW rockets on helicopters… they’re not currently destructible (yet).[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/cccd45d0e1c86e4f748801ba48f01bef95084c54.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Weapon Attachments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Suppressors[/b] – Gone are the days of DMR exclusivity: all weapons can now be silent and deadly. (With new audio! Suppressor sounds, along with several other gun sounds, have been overhauled for a more realistic and immersive audio experience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/1b1671c762e44efbbb92de4bb7cf8c303985169b.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Lasers[/b] – Available on every weapon platform. Just be careful not to give yourself away with that glowing beam in the dark…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/420ffb9f5b98b4db33f7c58122c2a9ce4f609f7a.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🪓 Melee Weapons[/b][/h3][p]Melee weapons are officially coming to EXFIL- a highly requested feature from our players. Combat Knives will be the first to make their debut, giving operators a silent and deadly close-range option. Shortly after, we’ll be looking to add more non-traditional blunt instruments, such as trench shovels and other improvised tools, for when you need to get up close and personal.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/9fc325a3e391e727ccfef52f9350b2f85262fbf3.gif"][/img][/p][h2]🎬 Animations[/h2][p]
Our new animator, Jake, has been hard at work overhauling some of EXFIL’s jankier weapon and player animations, breathing new life into the game’s look and feel. From smoothing out reloads to refining movement, his work is already making a big difference.[/p][p]There’s still a lot on the to-do list- everything from helicopter animations to vaulting mechanics is in the pipeline.  In the meantime, check out some of the recently added weapon check animations for LMG, pistol, and SMG-type weapons below. (GIFs courtesy of Jake’s Blender magic!) [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/c843b0be59131eb712953f2bdc23c785cab0218e.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/6e3181350cf7e78ae9b038dc1f12611f7011d24a.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/8d147fb2eb96be5cedb86a11ffa07b4602784a7d.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/527e1bc87ae3432de317ce4c4991c4bacd6aed26.gif"][/img][/p][h2]🗺️ Next Map[/h2][p]
We know Stone Dragon has just rolled out, but the team is already deep into work on our next exciting EXFIL map. We don’t want to give too much away just yet, but here are a couple of screenshots to give you a taste of what’s to come. Like Stone Dragon, the new map will feature a jungle biome, but unlike Stone Dragon’s heavy emphasis on verticality, this one will be far flatter in design and focus heavily on building-to-building gunfights.[/p][p]Our work on Stone Dragon isn’t done either - we’ll continue to tweak the map based on player feedback and have already begun an optimization pass to make it play smoother than ever. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/6b687dd46e1eb05ea7c6850fef86950bb4c190c1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/0a7b43f66e63e9ef10d62c78cb6c905c7344a980.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/8688d75d1742a5a03980c537a5746d1d9fd29b77.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]✅ Sign-Off[/h2][p]Thank you all for your continued interest and support for EXFIL- it means the world to our team. We’re genuinely excited to see your reactions to the content we have in the pipeline and can’t wait to share more in the months ahead.[/p][p]A special shout-out to all the new “bundlers” joining us-welcome to the fight! We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback, whether it’s in the Steam Discussions, on our Discord, or directly through the new feedback button in the main menu (which sends your input straight to our team). Your voices help shape the future of EXFIL, and we’re listening.[/p]

notes.title: 🪖EXFIL FIELD REPORT
notes.content:
Hey Operators!👋 

First order of business - shoutout to all the Operators who’ve been jumping into [b]EXFIL [/b]recently! It’s been great seeing fresh faces on the servers, squads forming up, and the community growing stronger every week.

The action doesn’t stop at EXFIL Dev HQ and we’re continuing to build out new features and additions we think you’ll love.

[h2]📒 Introducing: Field Reports[/h2]

Starting with this post, we're launching [b]Field Reports[/b] - a new monthly blog series that gives you updates on all things EXFIL. From new features and content previews to upcoming events and community highlights, these reports are your one-stop shop for what’s happening (and what’s coming next).

Not frequent enough for you?
Be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/6RNJ6ykn7D][b]join the EXFIL Discord[/b][/url] where the dev team teases new content daily and engages directly with the community.

[h2]🔭 What’s Coming[/h2]

There’s a lot on the horizon for EXFIL - from highly requested community features to completely new ways to engage with the battlefield.

[b][h3]Weapons[/h3][/b]
We’re expanding EXFIL’s arsenal with a mix of traditional and unconventional weapons. One of our core goals is to make each faction feel distinct through its weapon selection. Without spoiling too much, expect the roster to grow beyond ARs and DMRs to include SMGs, shotguns, explosive projectiles, sniper rifles, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/386d45bc4e4aa53b969d12281002340348f2306d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/4fa2b5c27d7c3075a87c207bcdef2f46fa60415c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/d18ffc194179ffe9cc30c4686d6092f9f625ef3b.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]New GameMode - VIP[/h3][/b]
We’re introducing a new twist to the classic EXFIL formula - VIP mode. In this mission type, players are tasked with hunting down a high-value target somewhere on the map. But it won’t be easy - you’ll only receive a rough last known location, and the target will be heavily guarded by an AI squad.

Once the VIP is neutralized, the mission shifts into overdrive. Enemy forces will descend on your team’s location, triggering an all-out response. Your new objective? Extract - fast, and alive.

In PvP, the stakes get even higher: one team plays the attackers hunting the VIP, while the other takes on the role of defenders. This mode brings a fresh layer of strategy and chaos to EXFIL’s tactical sandbox.

You can try VIP mode now in the test build, or keep a look out for the full release coming in an upcoming update. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/b628c21aeb63cf32347fa5384c56d3f24a077149.gif[/img]

[b][h3]New Biome[/h3][/b]
EXFIL’s map rotation already includes a wide range of biomes - and it’s about to grow. Our team is currently developing new maps set in a dense jungle environment. These will be our most complex yet, offering a radically different gameplay experience from the open sands of Renegade Oil or the forests of Northwoods. We’re aiming to get early prototypes onto the public test build soon so players can get a feel for what jungle warfare might look like in EXFIL.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/fb6831d033bf361ae69fa6227be3262e49cb2103.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/72c7731623fcd0e19378b6ef7ba79fe8e1b64308.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/57d5171bf27b4c49061385eda6a81adc7b5d99a4.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Attachments[/h3][/b]
Alongside new weapons, we’re also working on a wide selection of attachments to expand weapon customization. This includes highly requested additions like suppressors and performance-altering components like handguards. Suppressors are currently available to try out on DMRs in the Test Branch, but, because of their impact on sound detection and enemy reactions, we’re approaching their implementation carefully to keep the balance tight before pushing to the retail build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/46dde7e898970e24dd9433eabace70e114338be0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/1ae82bb283704c2eca0148e8f51b2004aac6d790.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Animations[/h3][/b]
We know EXFIL still has some rough edges when it comes to animation polish. That’s why we’re thrilled to welcome a new technical animator to the team. They’ve already begun revising existing weapon animations to elevate fluidity and feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/0673376305a42023e3e85bdfa9271db174e8fb55.gif[/img]

[h2]🆕 What’s New[/h2]

If you're returning to EXFIL, there have been a number of recent additions you’ll want to get familiar with to keep your edge in the field. From new gadgets to updated gun mechanics, here’s a breakdown of what’s new in the game.

[b][h3]New Gadgets[/h3][/b]
[b]Bomb Drone[/b] – One of the community’s favorite recent additions, the bomb drone builds on the utility of the original recon drone - but adds some serious bite. It allows you to scout enemy positions while carrying a deadly payload of three grenades that can be dropped from above. Detonations are slightly delayed, so make sure you time your drops carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/cb01132026e9b73975ac10ad788c8c1a174397bc.gif[/img]

[i][b]Dev Tip[/b]:* One of the biggest challenges with the bomb drone is managing battery life. Did you know the weight of your payload affects how quickly the battery drains? A full load (3 grenades) drains power the fastest - so spot early, drop fast, and save juice for recon on the way out.*[/i]

[b]Flare Gun[/b] – If you're planning to run night ops, the flare gun is quickly becoming an essential. Not only does it light up large areas and expose enemy positions, but it can also disorient enemies using NVGs when deployed mid-fight. The team is continuing to fine-tune its lighting effects and balance, so be on the lookout for future tweaks - and keep the feedback coming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/e01ad355e0325e4ecf0ab96192affce94f73fa96.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Gun Mechanics[/h3][/b]
[b]Breath Holding[/b] – A highly requested feature: you can now hold your breath while aiming down sights. Ideal for DMR users or anyone engaging at long range. We’re looking forward to seeing players take full advantage of this when sniper rifles are added to the arsenal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/25d561e3558554f7426066e2c5f360c6b177f3e8.gif[/img]

[b][h3]AI Updates[/h3][/b]
Since AI patrols were first introduced in March, there have been major improvements across the board. Updates have included smarter patrol routes, adjusted spawn locations, refined engagement behavior, more tactical reaction timing, and better use of intel intercepts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/d423bc47ee7e27bcbd89a3bd0f81395d0fbe5594.gif[/img]

[h2]🤖 Dev Insights[/h2]

Can’t get enough of the new AI update? Wondering what’s next for AI development in EXFIL?

MicroProse sat down with EXFIL dev Luomu for a behind-the-scenes interview series covering the current state of AI, how community feedback is shaping development, future goals, and more.

Looking for a glimpse of high-level tactical gameplay in EXFIL? The team at GLID Gaming recently put together a match showcasing tight coordination, tense decision-making, and a fight for extraction under pressure. Watch the full video below and check out their channel for more mil-sim and tactical shooter content.

Looking for a double dose of tactical immersion? MicroProse has you covered with the new Tactical Operators Bundle!

Featuring EXFIL and GROUND BRANCH, this bundle is built for players who love detailed planning and sharp execution. Two tactical shooters. One explosive combo.

Think you've got what it takes to lead your squad to victory? Prove it in one of our upcoming EXFIL tournaments — and show off your tactical skill under pressure.

notes.title: Week 1 patch notes and Developer Update
notes.content:
[b]Entry to Early Access[/b]

A huge thanks to our community, publisher Microprose and Development team for countless hours of maintenance, organization and play time during our Early Access entry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/9bad0fa0959b69e0b1574c6f173ea77fa6f393b7.png[/img]

Our commitment to iterative improvements and responding quickly to community continues from pre-release into early access as we play the game with active servers daily, take notes, discuss the game on discord, and update the [i]public-testing[/i] branch.

The public-testing branch is updated several times a week, and we play together with the community to ensure we catch bugs and feedback early. These updates are then packaged together in an update to the main game.

[b]Week 1 Patch Notes[/b]
The main focus that became critical was to smooth out the experience in regards to AFK players in the lobby and in game - who would stop the game from progressing. To tackle this AFK timers, and Vote-Kick features have been added.

We continue to support community hosted servers with a range of match and server settings, therefore the new AFK features have new admin settings to explore.

[list]
[*] AFK timeout configurable by server hosts
[*] AFK vote kick system configurable by hosts
[*] A magazine check system with animation only for m27 and hk416 atm
[*] the lobby will automatically start a timer if no admins are present
[*] A main menu redesign
[*] Match settings to allow pings to attach to players or not (for more hardcore server option)
[*] Players can now set a [Clan Tag] which helps hosts identify groups of players when organizing / balancing teams
[*] Various bug fixes (see Discord Changelog)
[/list]
 
We hope these features help combat problematic players, and enhance and empower you all to foster a positive public server experience.

[b]Join the Discord Community[/b]
The EXFIL Discord is growing with players who share our vision towards creating a [b]realistic infantry combat simulation[/b] with advice and input from both players and veterans.

Whether you are a player looking for a realistic fps (that will never feature hotdog suits and unicorn fart emotes) or you are a military enthusiast or veteran who wishes to join our advisor group - please jump in and find us in discord and in game!

We have a vision to break free of gear fear and overwhelming inventory simulations of recent tactical FPS games. Our goal is to make getting into the boots of a soldier more immediate when you choose to play EXFIL, and to focus on communication, teamwork and military realism.

[b]What's Next?[/b]
AI will be started in January, but first, we have something [i]cooking[/i]...tick tock...

See you in game, Misultin Out.

Our sources have confirmed the next Steam [b]Playtest Free Play Weekend[/b] is approaching! 

[h2]July 13-14th Exfil's latest update will go live [/h2]

This update should include a wide variety of updates, bug fixes, performance enhancements and new content. 

Here is a quick summary of what to expect

[list]
[*] [b]New Game mode "Rogue"[/b]

1 Rogue team needs to cross the map and EXFIL while hunted by 1-3 teams with the objective of destroying the intel. Periodic RFID pings update the intel location for the Hunters.  There are multiple copies of the intel.. As the [b]rogues[/b] do you? Decoy? Punch through? Split and rush the gaps? Compared to military football our new game mode is just about ready for testing. notes.title: Steam Pre-Sales Packages
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy Operators![/h3]

We appreciate everyone's patience as we have been rolling out a list of new features and improvements in preparation for the next steam test weekend (Likely mid July announcement soon). Feature work has been flying along and we believe the players will be pleasantly surprised with what we have in store for Steam Playtest #4. 

[h3]For today let's talk about the upcoming founders packs [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/e355d866fe0473c0dcdd1002ca37e8861d252cbe.png[/img]

We wanted to take this time to outline the details of our upcoming founders packs and why contributing early is the best way to ensure the biggest piece of your investment is well spent. 

[h3]Ugh Early access.. failed promises.. [/h3] We may be a small 3 man team but between us we have sold in excess of 6 million copies of games such as Squad, Post Scriptum (squad 44), Starship troopers, Beyond the Wire and several other smaller titles. We know exactly what we need to do and how to get there. In addition, we are incredibly lucky to be surrounded by a large support team of Mods, QA and contractors numbering more than 30 people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/f87bbb5967d8cd6cd385e65690ed081ab4efbe3a.png[/img]

[b]Play before you pay[/b] - As part of our commitment to consumers anyone is free to play the game on our Steam playtest weekends with no restrictions. You will know 100% where your money is going upfront and don't have to guess if you will enjoy the game.

[b]More Revenue to the Developers![/b] On a fully released steam game, once platform fees, credit card fees, publishing fees etc are calculated a team might expect to receive approx 40% of each dollar contributed. With direct pre-sales this number exceed 80%! 

[b]Support an independent development team[/b] One thing [b]Exfil is not is owned by shareholders[/b] or  investors and that makes.. A WORLD of difference. We set the timelines. We decide which way to take the game. We respond  to feedback in person. This  project means everything to us professionally and we will only die on our own sword. 

That is worth investing in.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/14b7c0bc4cf65c932fed814d5e1b3c6366a4909e.png[/img]

Depending on the supporter tier the below items will be received 

[b]Founders Steam Key[/b] - One founders Steam key all for you! 

[b]Founder Lobby Badge[/b] - Your name will be tagged in the Exfil lobby system as a founder

[b]Founder Discord Rank[/b] - Discord access to a closed Founder channel with closer access to give feedback to developers and get your feedback and wishlist in the spotlight 

[b]Founders Arm Patch in Game[/b] - Your character in game will have the option to sport a founders badge on their soldier letting everyone know you were there at the beginning of it all.  

[b]Alpha Campaign Badge[/b] - Each in game biome will constitute a campaign in the game will have an exclusive wearable patch to commemorate those  who served in that campaign. 

[b]Founders Credits[/b] - Get your name in the in game credits!

[b]Pre-Steam Launch Event[/b] - All founders will be entitles to attend our [b]one and only[/b] exclusive pre launch day event. 

[b]Friends Steam Keys[/b] - Several tiers include extra regular steam keys you can give to your friends or clanmates. 

[b]Tactical Mustache[/b] - Limited run Steam  tradeable assets such as the "Tactical Mustache" can be added to your character and also traded with other gamers on steam. We plan  to add more such items in the future. 

[b]Recruit Tier Donations[/b] - Investing at the officer Tier unlocks a very import service to the community as in addition to the items granted in the previous packs we will also donate (2)  two founders "Recruit Tier" packages to our  friends at Stackup.org or another fine veterans charity. They use these packages to give out to veteran and activity duty gamers and also to help drive charity events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/2337409e900d9233f28e7af1f0f2f4e2c722722b.png[/img]

[h2]Dev Update[/h2]
6 weeks of blood sweat and tears! Many new features and even more bug fixes. [b]Exfil[/b] continues to evolve the battlefield and bring us closer and closer to Early access release.

[b]Individual and Team loadouts[/b]

Players can now select from a variety of different weapons and see their team mates selection before the round start. This includes selecting custom attachments and throwables. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/98ced2c2fc4d69f2543f8046bb68c2572113589e.jpg[/img]

[b]Weapons Phase #1![/b]

Introduction of the HK416 series and its variant M27 serving as a Squad light machine gun as well as the MK17 series and it's variant the MK20 serving in a designated marksmen style setup. Huge thanks to our friends at Studio801 for the amazing effort and final poduct. Teams like your make this work easy! 

[url=https://studio-801.com/]Studio 801[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/229a82c0648d018ec00840685850b4d8da4f08ca.jpg[/img]

Newly added Ironsights for all weapons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/c8ca3f9db5f4b29efb76d20bd33ddecc927d771b.png[/img]

[b]Audio[/b]

As part of our Early Access goals we have been eagerly waiting to get back to the audio of the game where we know we can move the dial leaps and bounds. We have moved forward with these efforts and have spent the time to craft an audio relevance and distance manager to emulate the actual distant battlefield noise while still maintaining our focus on optimization. Through some clever architecture we can now hear battle sounds ranging across the map but don't have to actually calculate the unseen players several km's away. This coupled with our 32 player servers has given a really nice boost to our soundscape as ranging battles can be heard ringing out in the distance. Look forward to more improvements in this area as we enter our next dev cycle including a overhaul to our boom sounds!  

Thanks to the wonderful assets created by the geniuses over at Aftertouch Audio we will be able to rapidly increase the quality and fidelity of the Exfil environment. 

https://aftertouchaudio.com/[url=https://aftertouchaudio.com/]Aftertouchaudio.com[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/9806e734f99ea538bddbc7be21c4bd8eeade286d.png[/img]

Also based on consumer feedback we have made FSR available to Nvidia users as apparently it works great on those cards too! 

Be sure to carefully note the best settings for your video cards and give us all and any feedback in our discord!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/93d7800d898d8e6b7500b513851d06036e39baa6.jpg[/img]

All this and an additional 100+ bugs fixes and additional Quality of life improvements.

We will also be preparing to start our Founder's presales in the coming month and appreciate everyone's patience and support! Look forward to more news after the free weekend playtest.

notes.title: Monthly Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back folks! [/h2]

Wanted to take some time to update the community on our news for the past month. After an extremely busy Steam FPS fest we have been spending the past few weeks sorting out the bugs and bringing on new team members in our discord. 

We are happy to report some good progress and improvements along the way we want to make sure everyone is aware of! 

[b]Player visibility:[/b] We have improved visibility of teams and at the same time spent some energy on starting to build out the factions identities a bit more. The colourized shoulder armour in testing has been just the right amount of ID needed to minimize Teamkills. We plan to make this is a server side configureable (high vis uniforms) but will use it as the default for now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/b18c5dae37811eb30ebb73b2c2452624837ad8ba.png[/img]

[b]In addition[/b] we have updated all our clan patches and are starting to expand on the story and origins of each faction. Briefly below we have worked on

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/b605860727e1eea032bf516e15071e424627e7a1.png[/img]
[b]Bulls: [/b]North America based Veterans PMC group. Access to the American military complex means lots of gear and the latest weapons. They will be primarily armed with the SIG XM7 platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/026bf3fc78c52d70895cf9379da6fb27335f005d.png[/img]
[b]Dragons: [/b]A mix of Asian and Oceanic countries Soldiers of fortune the Dragons field high tech equipement  and a precision weapons in the HK416 platform and associated variants. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/8eb50036919ab5c55d3451c9644568f22946fc02.png[/img]
[b]Spartans: [/b]Spartans Represent the cream of the crop of European special forces alumni. This experienced and powerful faction chooses to arm itself with MK17 based series and associated platforms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/ab0252024cebfe37eb94097d29318382da5f4c97.png[/img]
[b]Tigers:[/b] Our final faction, The Tigers is comprised of Mercenaries drawn from throughout the east. An experienced faction with cold hard operators they draw their weaponry primarily from the vast patterns of the former soviet union and it offspring, sporting primarily the AK 200 series of weapons and associated gear.

We will continue to update you as the factions evolve. Stay tuned. 


As well here are some of the changes that  have been made/added to the game in the past week or so

[b]Lobby
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/c0a85c58695e10bee46b49c6f1fe4ca64d59e2f1.jpg[/img]
Added a variety of desired functionality including naming, locking server as well as kicking and muting individual players. The lobby also shows you how many people are in the match. This functionality generally extends into the live game now as well where appropriate.   

[b]In preparation for a refactor[/b] and integration of our new weapon sets we have added a variety of prototype scope setups for players to experiment with and test for us. We will continue collecting feedback over the next few tests before making a final decision on our approach. (Note these are on our placeholder weapons still currently but a lot of fun!) 

[b]Iron sights; Red Dot Sight; approx 3x scope[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/1749cdd225e5ce33e4cab3977957f95d56e73ed4.jpg[/img]

Some additional additions and improvements

[list]
[*] Refactored Name tags to be high quality UMG widgets. 
[*] Name tags now hide in ADS
[*] Intel Carrier now gets a HUD icon to let them know when they have the good! 
[*] Players list now available in game via menu
[*] Menus now respect the escape key! 
[*] Fixed various night vision bugs
[*] Added a new sandbox game mode so you can jump in a map with out a game mode running
[*] Fixed a variety of issues with radial damage for mortars and grenades
[*] Refactored the spectator pawn as part of future improvements for admins and streamers
[*] Prototyped the RC landdrone with Antitank mine
[*] Added Audio volume at 25% when alt tabbed (as opposed to zero)
[*] Players can see their steam status in the main menu
[*] Added team name to dead cam spectate target
[*] Spectators have a map
[*] Spectators can jump in and out of player views (Arrow keys Left/Right) and free cam (Arrow Up)
[*] Users can define their max FPS for the menus and run time
[*] Fixed shakey tree branches causing blur 
[*] Added a flashlight material for a realistic light cast
[*] Server Host is now marked in the lobby
[/list]
And a whole bunch more!

[b]Finally..[/b] as we prepare for new gamemodes and gear we needed a place to play so we have introduced "The Range" as a WIP playground with a variety of activities and ranges to keep people entertained during down time. We will continue to build out the map and its functional components over the next few months.

[b]Steam playtest will go live Sat morning (time to be announced exactly) but we have already begun activating groups of testers. [/b]

[h3]Here are the top 5 things you should probably know about Exfil[/h3]

1. First and foremost Exfil is a game meant to be played with [b]a groups of gamers locally hosted[/b]. We do put up some community servers to bring everyone together for testing but ultimately Exfil is a sandbox Milsim in which players are going to write their own stories. This is Chapter 1 

2. Exfil the game is made by [b]two developers[/b]. We each wear about 40 different hats including our day to day jobs. Set your expectations accordingly! We do our best and improvements take time. 

3. Exfil is a tactical shooter. It doesn't hold your hand or have flashing bells and lights to lead you to the next objective. To be properly prepared [b]everyone should watch the following video[/b] made by our community members B-wild and his merry misfits

[previewyoutube=5F0ZRWCbtew;full][/previewyoutube]

4. Exfil is alive and well today in our discord. We meet up there, play games together and even develop in unreal engine together. Anyone is welcome to the neighborhood, Don't be shy!

[url=https://discord.gg/playexfil]EXFIL DISCORD[/url]

5.  Exfil is community driven. We are in constant daily contact with our community and actively close their bugs and make improvements based on feedback. We check in with our communities and engage them in regular feedback and playtest sessions. [b]It takes a community to build an indie game! [/b]

[b]Steam playtest[/b] is a chance for you to engage the product and the developers and tell us how you would like to see Exfil evolve. 

And of course! Don't forget to[b] wishlist Exfil [/b]if you like what you see in the playtest. 

Much Appreciated, Exfil team

notes.title: Exfil Update Aug 2023
notes.content:
[b]Hello there friends and followers from the Misultin Team[/b]

Nice to meet you all! (I am new!)

We have a progress update and would like to thank everyone for their continued patience. 

First I’d like to introduce myself, Chris Greig (also known as Irontaxi). I am a long time unreal developer and have worked on a variety of military titles over the years. As a long term development friend of Roberto’s (Misultin's founder) I offered some months ago to come on board and help push Exfil down the path to early access. 

As such.. We have made progress and I will continue to find time to update you on that progress. 

[h2]PORT LOBOS[/h2]

I have spent the past 2 months creating the second map for Exfil Port Lobos. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/8e874505a686845070f77e232a7ead6d5db32da2.jpg[/img]

Numerous large POI’s centered around a large port which may or may not be part of a mission objective area depending on the random nature of mission generation! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/2d3ff83d1a56f755b3c84c8325c58ecbef89d64a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/15d6fe36e04ae36a58159a4a4e4deac91ca9f385.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/1ac9a5050dac3b061f760487b61a006d50c2220f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/64d58ac47dcccd668f419620916bcd5db41d4930.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/9ca57be2e634398d76f0d447d51088858b4608aa.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/1f9023ecc9b4916b897e7ac44dba9a782c3286bb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/a5136a299236ce854d7f78ad329b719cefaf643c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/dd65e02d6c21ec3b3e8a40d319ba82719db9d2aa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Feature Development
[/h2]
At the same time Roberto has also been chasing and removing nasty little bugs and adding all water-related features such as suffocating (yay!) and various effects. In addition we are testing out a bunch of new features like showing friendlies on GPS, finalizing the Join in Progress feature, adding shootable lights and glass in windows as well as SFX to the radio system. 

Along with these updates and changes we have just restarted the process of testing internally and hope to have more news and videos/screenshots of that in the near future! The feedback from these sessions will be invaluable to giving us a final checklist of features we might want to add before moving to an early access release. 

Keep and eye out for it as we will be recruiting testers in the near future! 

Also feel free to join us on our official discord server [url=https://discord.gg/YZX68Baunv]Misultin Discird[/url]

Cheers!

Misultin Team
